scenes.title: simpligen VideoStudio
scenes.subtitle: Local video generation. Zero API cost.
scenes.narration: This is simpligen VideoStudio. A video generator that runs entirely on your own machine.

scenes.title: Write a scene file
scenes.subtitle: Plain JSON: title, subtitle, narration, colours
scenes.narration: You describe the video as a short JSON file. Each scene has a title and a line of narration.

scenes.title: Render locally
scenes.subtitle: Pillow draws, offline TTS speaks, ffmpeg encodes
scenes.narration: Pillow draws each slide. Offline text to speech reads the narration. And ffmpeg times, fades, and encodes everything into an MP4.

scenes.title: What it costs
scenes.subtitle: $0 per render. Seconds of laptop CPU.
scenes.narration: There are no API keys and no per render fees. A one minute video costs a few seconds of laptop time.

scenes.title: vs HyperFrames
scenes.subtitle: HTML + headless Chrome vs slides + ffmpeg
scenes.narration: HyperFrames renders animated HTML in headless Chrome. simpligen trades that power for a tiny footprint and near instant renders.

scenes.title: This video made itself
scenes.subtitle: python3 -m simpligen examples/demo.json site/demo.mp4
scenes.narration: This video was generated by simpligen, from the file you just heard about. Thanks for watching.
